data.name: The Black Pyramid
data.detailed_description:
You are Dr. Mehdi Algun, a linguist and researcher specializing in cutting edge pattern analysis. When military operatives arrive unannounced at your New York research lab, you're given no choice. Within hours, you're on a transport to a classified facility in the Arctic Circle. An impossible obsidian pyramid has appeared around the world broadcasting signals no machine or person can decode.

You shouldn't have said yes.

As you crack each layer of the Pyramid's puzzles, you get closer to the truth at the cost of sanity. Scientists walk into the pyramid and immolate. Others walk into the arctic storms and are found frozen to death.

You and your colleague Sarah are the only ones that can get to the bottom of this. One by one, 82 people feed the pyramid their suffering. Their fear. Their death.

And you? You've been dreaming of this pyramid your entire life. It's been waiting for you. It knows what you did as a child. It knows the darkness you carry.

The pyramid has a purpose. When the time comes, you'll have a choice: kneel and become the herald of annihilation, or join the cleansed.

Some survival is worse than death.

DECODE THE LANGUAGE OF EXTINCTION

Unravel a recursive unknown language that doesn't just describe reality, but alters it. Every translation brings you closer to understanding. Every understanding brings you closer to transformation. The limits of your language are the limits of your world. This language has no limits.

SURVIVE THE WORLD'S COLLAPSE

No superpowers. No military arsenal. Improvise weapons from what your environment provides: stun batons, knives, whatever you can find. Evade or eliminate rabid personnel and corrupted test subjects. Every death feeds the pyramid. Every choice matters.

FACE WHAT YOU'VE ALWAYS BEEN

Explore a doomed research installation where reality fractures further the deeper you descend. Impossible geometry. Bodies manifesting from thin air. Colleagues you trusted becoming vessels for something ancient. The truth isn't in the pyramid, it's in you.

CHOOSE YOUR ENDING

Your trauma made you compatible. Your darkness kept you alive. Now the pyramid offers ascension. Multiple outcomes determined by your actions, your victims, and how much of yourself you're willing to sacrifice. Some doors can't be closed once opened. Every choice will mark your fate.

GAME FEATURES

  • Solo developer's vision - A narrative-driven psychological horror experience crafted by an independent creator

  • First-person - psychological horror with survival and combat elements

  • Over 100 Puzzles - Innovative decoding systems that border linguistics, soundwaves and more.

  • 200+ Collectibles - Environmental storytelling across 10+ Unique Levels and vast possibilities to explore.

  • Branching narrative - Your choices, dialogue options and casualties determine multiple endings

The Great One is coming. You are the herald it chose.

data.short_description: A Black Pyramid materializes across the globe. Dr. Mehdi Algun must decipher why, before its hunger for death and suffering consumes everything. An ancient cycle of cleansing has begun. As madness spreads and humanity tears itself apart, choose: become the destroyer, or join the cleansed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT / Intel® Arc™ A750 Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages or may not be suitable for viewing at work. It includes moderate gore, psychological and cosmic horror themes, occasional depictions of murder and suicide, and mild use of strong language.
